speech.heard: Rate your life from 0 to 10, Finland answers 7.8, Afghanistan answers 1.4. Finland is the world's highest, feeling closest to the best possible life. Right behind, Iceland has 7.5, Denmark has 7.5, Costa Rica has 7.4 and Sweden has 7.3. For major economies, USA has 6.8, while India has 4.5. Toward the bottom, Malawi has 3.3. Afghanistan is the world's lowest at 1.4, right near the bottom step. Which step are you on?
